workshop: L4D2 2560050233 RE8 Village Karambit (CS:S knife slot)
name: Karambit
note: The Ghost's execution knife (ClassKnives.csv). 17.4 cm: the finger ring at -Y, the handle along +Y, the claw curving toward +Z with its edge on the inside of the curve (+Z), so tip [0,1,0] (the handle's way to the blade) and up (the spine, the outside of the curve) [0,0,-1]. The origin is the middle of the handle. Markers: Tip (the claw's point), Edge (on the inner curve), Pommel (the ring).
